entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A sword that slew a false god; power still radiates from it after she tore magic from Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane from which a false god tore magic.

entities.name: The Unbeholden
entities.description: A threat to sacred groves, against which a protector stands.

events.summary: A false god tears magic from Dominaria and is slain by the Mirari sword.
events.quote: Even after a false god tore magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.
